'''Roff''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Roff had crossed paths with the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[To'iir]] and [[Liadden]], causing them to flee into the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].
